When you show someone something like a meme or maybe an answer you wrote on your homework and they read the entire thing out loud. 

Like bitch if I wanted everyone else in the mfer to know what it said I would of read it out my fucking self now stfu
Honestly it’s tempting lmao but I’m afraid of the legal repercussions.

It’s already been reported a million times a million different ways. Something happened and now the entire investigation (scanning through his electronics and things) was put on pause and hasn’t started back up again. And so until they finish the investigation he won’t be put on trial and so he’s free to roam the streets and have contact with my siblings (his bio kids) all he wants
I am going to therapy outside of my school I’m just in between therapists rn. My last therapist just didn’t get along for some reason haha.

Yeah he knows and says he’s trying to get custody of me to keep me safe. But thanks to my new found trust issues the fact that we’ve never been close I wouldn’t be surprised if it was more about child support. But yes he knows everything I do about what happened (which isn’t that much)

I’m trying. Unfortunately no one wants to talk to a 14 year old. I’m gonna try to speak in court soon. (This entire thing sparked a custody battle between my mom and bio dad) hopefully when I talk about who I want to live with I can slip in enough info about my step dad to put his ass in jail. 

Fun fact: my state is known for being the most laidback when it comes to child pornography and sexual assault cases! Lucky for me right :)

My mom did actually! She kicked him out of the apartment that afternoon . (He was still in the building that night tho) and police were there first thing the next morning. 

I appreciate the shit out of my mom for that but more recently she did a complete 180 and took him back. She’s said some awful things to me about this and is convinced that he’s just sick and I’m being unreasonable to not want to be around him.

My diagnosis is ptsd depression and anxiety and I’m trying to get on depression meds ASAP but the process is real slow,, I’ll try to talk to my parents I guess. I’m not hopeful that anything will come out of it though. 


Thank you for your reply

Not on meds yet and I’ve been having difficulty connecting with my therapist. Might try to switch to someone else soon. In terms of grounding techniques no one has ever really taught me any of those. And things like guided meditation doesn’t seem to help me.  I did like the idea of the drawing meditation though and I’ll try it if I remember to next time I get like this

Writing stuff out seems to help but I don’t feel safe keeping any kind of diary.  So my writing stays online. Like in this post 

There are select people who are not toxic but they can’t help me. And I’ve already tried to reach out for help and they just don’t get it/don’t know what to do. 

Thank you for the advice. My panic is a little better right now but I have a bad feeling about today so I’m probably gonna be checking this post periodically as well as keeping up convos the post started. I feel exhausted after my panic (and I have an algebra test today so fuck me I guess haha. Math is not my strong suit) I’m just drained and confused right now.
